summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js on the installer's host at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle with a rotated constant array (WV8StW/n7gIxM) and a custom decoder (hc1jfK9) over a permuted alphabet, so its actual behavior is opaque to inspection. The package's stated purpose (Bandwidth Voice BXML step definitions for @onereach) is unrelated to shipping or executing a Bun-only obfuscated runtime blob; the rest of the package is ordinary transpiled TypeScript in dst/. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to run an obfuscated bundled script at install time bypasses Node-based require-graph analysis and executes attacker-controlled code on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
